dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual narrowing of the lateral margins starting from the mid-body and continuing toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-reflectance mature white skin tone with minimal grayscale variation across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A series of small, high-reflectance punctate spots or pitting visible along the posterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A continuous, narrow longitudinal groove along the posterior dorsal axis, characterized by a sharp shadow-defined vertical ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: A single, high-contrast dark elliptical aperture (blowhole) centrally located on the anterior dorsal surface.
